Chapter 775: Chapter 4 Human Civilization Part 10 (Subscribe Please)

Chapter 775: Chapter 4 Human Civilization Part 10 (Subscribe Please)

Lin Yuan stepped into the Tenth Rank not long ago and soon grasped the first Pillar-level Fusion Rule, becoming a Grade A Tier 10.

That is, the Tenth Rank Summit.

But it was not until now that he finally carved out a complete Tenth Stage Martial Tao Chapter.

During this process, he also experienced tens of thousands of years in the Two-dimensional World.

This shows the difficulty of formulating the Tenth Stage Martial Tao Chapter.

In fact, with Lin Yuan’s Against-Heaven’s Understanding, he had already created hundreds, even thousands of beginnings for the Tenth Rank Chapter.

...

But they were all unsatisfying, as he felt the direction was not quite right.

It was only after obtaining everything about the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses from the half-meter tall elder inside White Paper…

…that he finally locked down the essence of the Tenth Rank Chapter, taking only two and a half years to carve it out.

“The Tenth Stage Martial Tao Chapter, in addition to the corresponding understanding of rules, many Pillar-level Fusion Rules, its most core aspect lies in reshaping the physical soul, making it more perfect, closer to those special beings nurtured by the cosmos,” thought Lin Yuan to himself. To achieve this, two things were necessary: Against-Heaven’s Understanding and various structural diagrams of the physical souls of special beings, including Different Species.

The two were indispensable.

“My physical soul now…”

As Lin Yuan carefully sensed it over, during the creation of the Tenth Stage Martial Tao Chapter, his physical soul had also been evolving towards perfection.

Only when the Tenth Rank Chapter was perfectly carved out did Lin Yuan’s physical soul transform to the ultimate extreme.

At this moment, Lin Yuan’s physical soul was mysterious, not inferior to those special beings with powerful talents. He might still not match up to the unique special beings, but the gap was not significant.

“The reason why special beings have such a low probability of reaching the Ultimate is that they are Innate powerful, lacking a Weak Period, and lacking that kind of relentless will. However, their physical souls definitely have something worth learning,” Lin Yuan silently pondered.

Now the Martial Tao Tenth Rank Chapter draws from the strengths of those special beings. As for their weaknesses? Which Evolver from Human Civilization didn’t grow from utter weakness to strength?

There is no such thing as being innately powerful.

“Almost there.”

Lin Yuan repeatedly deliberated and thought over the Martial Tao Tenth Rank Chapter and finally nodded in satisfaction.

The Tenth Rank Chapter now truly matched the version he had envisioned. Other Evolution Path Tenth Rank Chapters emphasized understanding and Enlightenment of Rules.

However, the Martial Path Evolutionary Path’s Tenth Rank Chapter returns to the physical soul, showing the path of evolution from the root.

“Goddess of Wisdom.”

Lin Yuan immediately connected to the Goddess of Wisdom.

“Respected Scholar Lin Yuan, Eighth-Level Citizen, Goddess of Wisdom is pleased to serve you,” intoned the Goddess of Wisdom in a grave and cool voice.

“I wish to upload the Martial Tao Tenth Rank Chapter.”

Lin Yuan immediately uploaded the Martial Tao Tenth Rank Chapter to the terminal of the Goddess of Wisdom.

…

Virtual World.

The Xia Qin Supreme Being and several other Supreme Beings gathered once again.

“The Martial Tao Tenth Rank Chapter?”

“That youngster created the Martial Tao Tenth Rank Chapter?”

The Xia Qin Supreme Beings were briefly stunned, then promptly accepted it.

Lin Yuan even comprehended the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule, creating the Martial Tao Tenth Rank Chapter wasn’t so inconceivable.

“Let me have a look.”

The Void God Ultimate Being immediately started to peruse it.

Nowadays, within Human Civilization, Lin Yuan’s importance is second only to the nine Supreme Beings. His Tenth Rank Chapter was directly judged by the Supreme Beings.

“This Tenth Rank Chapter?”

The Ancient Power Supreme Being was slightly taken aback.

As the ultimate existence skilled in the Rule of Power and specializing in the physical body, the Ancient Power Supreme Being instantly recognized that the Martial Tao Tenth Rank Chapter involved reshaping the physical body.

“Impressive, indeed.”

“How many special beings did this youngster dissect to have such a profound understanding of the physical body?” the Ancient Power Supreme Being wondered more and more inconceivably as he read.

High understanding of rules by Lin Yuan? He could somewhat force an explanation. After all, many rules pervade the Cosmic Starry Sky, and to those peerless geniuses, they are palpable.

But the mysteries of the physical body?

Especially the mysteries of the physical body in the Martial Tao Tenth Rank Chapter, are all directed towards the Dao of the physical body, the location of the Great Dao of the cosmos.

Such profound understanding of the physical body should be beyond a youngster like Lin Yuan, right?

“And the soul?” the Feather Butterfly Supreme Being said with a slightly grave expression.

She also noticed the core thread of the Tenth Rank Chapter, which fundamentally lies in the physical soul.

“Martial Arts Evolutionaries who practice up to the Martial Tao Tenth Rank, reaching Perfection in the Tenth Rank Layer, will have a much higher possibility of stepping into Tier 11 in the future, even touching the Ultimate offers a minuscule benefit,” nodded the Xia Qin Supreme Being.

Do not underestimate the significance of a transcendent physical soul, especially when striving for the Ultimate. A perfected physical soul might not provide great help, but it will at least not be a hindrance.

“Indeed, it is very good.”

The Void God Supreme Being nodded slightly, even he saw the rare and valuable aspect of the Martial Tao Tenth Rank Chapter, returning to the physical soul, emphasizing the shaping of the foundation.

“This Tenth Rank Chapter is worth at least three billion Merit Points.”

“Three billion Merit Points? That is somewhat low, I think it is worth at least four or five billion Merit Points.”

“Let’s say five billion? I feel like the exposition on the physical body in the Tenth Rank Chapter could be applied to other Evolution Paths.”

…

The various Supreme Beings conversed with each other and finally rendered a five billion Merit Points valuation.

…

Milky Way Main Star.

As Lin Yuan waited, he once again immersed himself in the practice and enlightenment of the Dao.

Just then…

“Respected Scholar Lin Yuan, Eighth-Level Citizen, your Martial Tao Tenth Rank Chapter has been judged…” began the solemn and cool voice of the Goddess of Wisdom.

“Judged already?” Lin Yuan opened his eyes, slightly expectant.

“The final evaluation result values the Tenth Stage Martial Tao Chapter at fifty billion merit points…” the voice of the Goddess of Wisdom rang out.

“Fifty billion merit points?”

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face.

He remembered the Ninth Stage Martial Tao Chapter was valued at only two billion merit points?

Those two billion merit points even included the results of the bloodline cultivation system.

But now, the Tenth Stage Chapter is worth fifty billion straight away?

Even though Lin Yuan used nearly a hundred exotic treasures, fifty billion merit points was still a huge fortune for him.

In the Human Civilization Treasury, the exchange price for Twelve-Star Strange Treasures starts at a billion merit points.

Fifty billion merit points could exchange for fifty of the lowest-value Twelve-Star Strange Treasures.

“Right.”

“What’s the current ranking of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path now?”

Lin Yuan immediately began to check.

After uploading the Ninth Stage Martial Tao Chapter, the Martial Path Evolutionary Path’s ranking was forty-second in the Southern Star Region.

Being forty-second in the Southern Star Region, one of the five major star regions of human civilization, would roughly put it in the three to four hundred rank- range of the entire human civilization’s evolutionary paths.

“The rankings of the Southern Star Region’s Evolutionary Path… Huh? First?”

Lin Yuan was somewhat surprised as he saw the final ranking.

Even though he had anticipated a spike in ranking after uploading the Tenth Rank Chapter, thanks to those fifty billion merit points being there,

The higher the evaluation in merit points, it meant that the three goddesses and even the supreme beings saw great potential, signifying even greater potential.

But Lin Yuan hadn’t expected to soar straight to first place in the Southern Star Region rankings.

This was one of the five major star regions, not some Star Domain or Star Alliance!

The evolutionary paths in the Southern Star Region’s rankings were primarily Eleventh Rank evolutionary paths, and having the Ninth Rank Martial Tao Evolutionary Path at forty-second was already incredibly unbelievable.

“The ranking of human civilization’s evolutionary paths…”

Lin Yuan shifted his gaze to the ranking of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path amongst the evolutionary paths of human civilization.

The rankings of human civilization’s evolutionary paths consist of all evolutionary paths recorded by human civilization, including the rankings of all evolutionary paths as well as the nine great supreme evolutionary paths.

The ranking of human civilization’s evolutionary paths is the most prestigious.

“Tenth place…”

Lin Yuan glanced up at the evolutionary paths now ranked ahead of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

There were only nine.

And these nine evolutionary paths were all supreme evolutionary paths.

“Has the Martial Path Evolutionary Path become the strongest evolutionary path beneath the supreme evolutionary paths?”

Lin Yuan silently thought to himself.

Of course, to say it’s the strongest isn’t quite accurate.

The ranking of human civilization’s evolutionary paths is determined by many aspects, including potential, which holds significant weight.

But regardless, the Martial Path Evolutionary Path has now become the most pinnacle of all the vast and numerous evolutionary paths recorded in human civilization.

…

The rise in the ranking of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path swiftly caused a huge stir within the entirety of human civilization.

After all, the Martial Path Evolutionary Path’s latest ranking was tenth in human civilization, overwhelming a host of Eleventh Rank Peak evolutionary paths and taking the top spot on the Southern Star Region leaderboard, shocking countless evolutionary and high-level citizens.

“Ranked tenth in human civilization’s evolutionary paths? This Martial Path Evolutionary Path is too formidable.”

“Just by uploading the Tenth Rank Chapter, it surged from around three to four hundredth place to tenth?”

“Hahaha, I told you guys the future of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path was immeasurable, but you wouldn’t believe me.”

…

Countless evolvers began to discuss fervently, as there hadn’t been an evolutionary path that reached the top of a major star region while only at the Tenth Rank since the beginning of the Starry Sea Era.

Indeed, the human civilization’s evolutionary path rankings emphasis potential as one of the main criteria, but to become a Tier 11 evolutionary path, doesn’t low potential?

…

Thunder Rain Star Region.

Loulan He, one and a half meters tall, suddenly leaped up.

“I said the Martial Path Evolutionary Path was quite good.”

Loulan He was extremely excited; he can be considered a witness to the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

When the Martial Path Evolutionary Path was only at the Second Layer, he took notice of it and began to cultivate it.

He even defied his father’s will for this.

“Father, Father.”

Loulan He immediately began to contact his father.

“Little He.”

The ethereal figure of Loulan Yu appeared in front of him.

“Father, have you seen the latest ranking of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path?”

Loulan He said excitedly.

“I have seen it.”

Loulan Yu spoke gravely.

The hottest topic inside human civilization at the moment was the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, even the different species were aware of it.

“Your choice was very good.”

Loulan Yu looked at his son, “Keep cultivating on the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.”

“Because… ”

Loulan Yu said this but did not continue.

“Because of what?”

Loulan He asked cheerfully.

“Because…”

Loulan Yu looked solemn, his tone tinged with emotion, “This could very well be our human civilization’s… tenth supreme evolutionary path.”
